description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryDecorator class, which provides methods to set related entities such as Employee, PayPeriod, PayGrade, and CurrencyType on an EmployeeSalary object. It acts as a decorator or helper for managing EmployeeSalary associations in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that provides methods to set related entities for EmployeeSalary objects, such as Employee, PayPeriod, PayGrade, and CurrencyType, using reference lookups.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeSalary object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity on EmployeeSalary based on an employee number.

methods.name: setPayPeriodById
methods.description: Sets the PayPeriod entity on EmployeeSalary based on its ID.

methods.name: setPayGradeById
methods.description: Sets the PayGrade entity on EmployeeSalary based on its ID.

methods.name: setCurrencyTypeById
methods.description: Sets the CurrencyType entity on EmployeeSalary based on its ID.
